notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Policy 02-11-01 (revised 2008) and Procedure 02-11-01 (1996) are in force on that date per their version notes (unchanged digests 2015-2020). The FAQ, FMFL page, handbook pages and chairs' guidelines are undated captures from 2017-11 to 2018-05 (reference period 2017-18) and accepted as in force.

Governing documents: Policy 02-11-01 and its handbook restatement (2018_05). Procedure 02-11-01 (1996) still gives two weeks of paid parental leave; the later Policy gives four workweeks and governs (c5 flagged conflicting_sources). The FAQ and FMFL page are summaries; they supply the childbirth length (V1b) of the governing medical-leave provision.

The brochure (May 2017) is a summary; it says only that a faculty member 'may request' a year off the tenure clock for medical or family leave, which the governing policy refines (c10, c11). The chairs' guidelines hold paperwork steps only.

Birth parent chain: medical leave c1 (up to 26 workweeks; its childbirth pay c2, 6 to 8 weeks at full salary, within it) -> unpaid medical extension c3 (up to 12 months, discretionary; LTD c4 the alternative) ; paid parental leave c5 (4 workweeks) also_available with c1 ('in addition to medical leave') ; unpaid family leave c7 also_available with c5 ; FMLA c8 concurrent with c1 (and c5); family leaves c5+c7 capped at 52 weeks (leave_limits).

Non-birth parent chain: paid parental leave c5 (4 workweeks) ; paid family-care leave c6 (up to 4 weeks, care of a spouse with a serious condition, 24 months' service) also_available with c5 ; unpaid family leave c7 also_available with c5 ; FMLA c8 concurrent with c5; c5+c6+c7 capped at 52 weeks (leave_limits).

Not components: Policy III.D (part-time work during medical leave with dean approval; the leave still counts as full-time); premium continuation during leaves (Policy V); job and evaluation protection (IV.E) noted on c7; 'any accrued vacation time' (Policy IV.A) mentioned without terms, so no own_accrual component.

Documents cited but not saved: Certification of Physician or Practitioner FORM 0189 PITT 1517 (Policy Attachment A) and the physician certification forms; University Long-Term Disability Plan; Policy 07-07-02 (FMLA, for research associates and postdocs); Guidelines for Deans for FMFL Paperwork; 'guidelines for faculty' (FAQ #18-19); DOL FMLA notice (fmlaen.pdf); Faculty Handbook (PDF); Policy AC 26 is not cited in the sources (named only in a version note).
No calendar is stated (Bylaws mention 'two academic terms' and 'one academic term or semester' without a term length); default applies.
